channel.title: 8PCK Trends
channel.description: One packaging story a day, read the way a buyer would.

item.title: PFAS Claims Are Moving Down the Supply Chain. What Should Bottle Buyers Ask For?
item.description: A US water utility is suing two packaging manufacturers over alleged PFAS contamination. For buyers, the lesson is not the lawsuit — it is the paperwork you will be asked for next year.

item.title: Big Beauty Brands Are Buying Stock Packaging. Here Is What That Means for Smaller Ones
item.description: Cosmetics Business reports that major beauty names are moving to stock packs to cut lead times. For smaller brands, the same shelves are now a competitive advantage — if you know how to ask.

item.title: Berlin Packaging Buys Premi: Consolidation Is Reaching the Mid-Market
item.description: Another distributor acquisition in beauty packaging. For brands buying 5,000–50,000 pieces a year, the practical question is who still answers the phone.

item.title: “Low MOQ” Is Now a Marketing Claim. Here Is What It Actually Costs
item.description: Beauty Packaging writes that low MOQs are no longer a differentiator. The number on the website and the number on the quotation are rarely the same thing.

item.title: California EPR Fees Are Landing on Packaging Weight. What It Changes in a Bottle Spec
item.description: Plastics News reports that plastics face high fees under California's EPR rules, with exemptions possible for recyclable formats. For a bottle buyer, the fee is a function of material and grams — both are in your control.

item.title: Enzymatic Recycling of PE and PP Lacks Evidence. What That Means for a Packaging Claim
item.description: Researchers say the evidence for enzymatic recycling of polyethylene and polypropylene is thin. For a bottle buyer, the practical lesson is simpler: design for the recycling stream that exists today.

item.title: Mono-Material Packaging Is Beauty's Next Shift. What It Changes in a Bottle Spec
item.description: Beauty Packaging reports that mono-material packs are moving from pilot to shelf. For a bottle buyer it is a short list of changes: the cap, the label, the pump — not the bottle itself.

item.title: The EU Is Consulting on Bio-Based Plastics. What It Means for a Bottle Claim
item.description: The European Commission has opened a consultation on bio-based plastic packaging. For buyers, the useful question is not “is it bio-based” but “which claim can I prove”.
